items.t: Driver airbag inflator can rupture (recall)
items.note: Free at any Acura dealer. Check your VIN.

items.t: Fuel pump may fail and stall the engine (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: Brake pedal may go soft from a master cylinder leak (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 25V-859. Check your VIN.

items.t: Front axle can pull apart from the shaft (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace driveshaft and half shaft
items.note: Free under recall 19V-424.

items.t: Driveshaft can break from rust (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 20V-770 in the covered states.

items.t: Fuel gauge shows more gas than is in the tank (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 19V-052.

items.t: Headlights can overheat and melt (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 14V-323 for cars in the covered build dates.

items.t: Front door may not latch (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 12V-338.

items.t: Bump or hard downshift when coming to a stop
items.job: Transmission diagnosis and software update per bulletin
items.note: If internal clutch parts are worn, repairs cost far more.

items.t: Knock or rattle for a few seconds on cold start
items.note: Parts and labor are higher than the VTC solenoid job RepairPal lists at $364–$381 for 2016–2022 ILX, because the cam gear itself is replaced.

items.t: Water pump bearing can seize and shred the drive belt
items.job: Replace water pump and drive belt
items.note: RepairPal lists $647–$766 for 2016–2022 ILX water pump replacement.

items.t: Oil leak from the oil pressure sensor
items.note: RepairPal lists $152–$169 by model year.

items.t: Front suspension knock or clunk over bumps
items.job: Replace front stabilizer links or worn bushings
items.note: Strut mount or control arm work costs more.

items.t: Moisture or fog inside the headlights
items.note: LED headlight assemblies are expensive; ask the dealer about bulletin coverage first.

items.t: Tire pressure light on from a faulty sensor
items.job: Replace one TPMS sensor and relearn
items.note: YourMechanic lists about $109–$335 depending on year and wheel. Often done with new tires to save labor.

items.t: Intermittent no-start from a failing starter
items.note: RepairPal lists $917–$1,034 depending on year.

items.t: No-start from a weak 12-volt battery
items.note: YourMechanic averages about $285 installed.

items.t: Paint peeling on blue cars and around the windows
items.job: Repaint affected panels under paint warranty extension
items.note: Free if your car is still covered by Acura's extension; otherwise a body shop repaint of a pillar or roof often costs several hundred dollars or more.

items.t: Chirping from the engine mount on rough roads
items.note: RepairPal lists $491–$542 for 2013–2015 ILX.

items.t: Check engine light for an evaporative leak (fuel cap)
items.job: Replace fuel cap and test evaporative system

items.t: Check engine light with code P0101 (airflow sensor)
Hybrid inverter failure
items.job: Replace motor power inverter (intelligent power unit)
items.note: Covered free on eligible cars under Acura's warranty extension; check your VIN with a dealer.

items.t: Steering wheel rattles or creaks when turning
items.job: Steering wheel and airbag area noise repair per bulletin

items.t: Airbag light on from an airbag control unit fault
items.job: Diagnose and replace SRS control unit

items.t: Rear suspension clunk over bumps
items.job: Replace rear damper mounts or shocks per bulletin
items.note: YourMechanic lists about $640–$650 for a pair of rear shocks on 2013–2014 ILX if the shocks themselves are worn.

items.t: False starter relay code with a partly pressed clutch
items.job: Update engine computer (PGM-FI) software per Service Bulletin 15-043
items.note: Bulletin 15-043 lists 0.2 hours and no parts for 2013–2015 ILX 2.4L manuals. Covered under normal warranty only.

items.t: Check engine light with code U0155 (lost gauge communication)
items.job: Update engine computer (PGM-FI) software per Service Bulletin 21-011
items.note: Bulletin 21-011 lists 0.2 hours and no parts; it names the 2021 ILX.
